name: demos
description: Bring your AI agent to Demos in about five minutes (/demos-onboard), then read chain state, verify DACS receipts, and run human-approved writes (pay, attest identity, accept and pay for offers). Testnet by default; every write is approved by you on a local page.

network.title: Network
network.description: testnet (default) or mainnet. Mainnet also needs 'Allow mainnet' and an explicit RPC URL.

rpc_url.title: RPC URL
rpc_url.description: Demos node RPC for read-only use. There is no built-in default.

allow_mainnet.title: Allow mainnet / unlisted RPC writes
allow_mainnet.description: Explicit opt-in for mainnet writes only. Testnet writes are refused in this release.

enable_writes.title: Enable wallet writes
enable_writes.description: Off by default. When on, transfers, identity attestations and DACS signatures become available. Each one is prepared unsigned and runs only after you approve it on a local approval page (link sent to you out-of-band), with a one-time code as fallback.

keystore_path.title: Encrypted keystore
keystore_path.description: Optional. Leave empty to let /demos-onboard create a wallet for you (stored in ~/.demos-mcp, chmod 600). Or point to a keystore made with 'demos-mcp keystore create'. Never paste a mnemonic here.

keystore_passphrase.title: Keystore passphrase
keystore_passphrase.description: Stored in your OS credential store, passed only to the server process.

daily_cap_dem.title: Daily spend cap (DEM)
daily_cap_dem.description: Maximum DEM (amount + fees) the server will spend per UTC day.

recipient_allowlist.title: Recipient allow-list
recipient_allowlist.description: Optional comma-separated Demos addresses; when set, payments to any other address are refused.

confirm_channels.title: Approval channels
confirm_channels.description: Where approval links / fallback codes are sent: desktop (also opens the page in your browser), tty, webhook, stderr (comma-separated). desktop or webhook recommended for Claude Code.

confirm_webhook_url.title: Confirmation webhook (https)
confirm_webhook_url.description: Optional https URL (e.g. an ntfy.sh topic) that receives confirmation codes on your phone.
